decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;mso-layout-grid-align:none;
text-autospace:none"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">The proposed ground floor rear extension, by reason of its excess depth and siting, would give rise to an overbearing, unneighbourly and visually obtrusive form of development which would result in an unacceptable impact on the amenities of 35 Woodhall Gate. The proposed development would thereby be contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2021), Policy D3.D(7) of the London Plan (2021), Policy DM1 of the Development Management Policies Local Plan document (2013) and the relevant provisions of the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></span></p>

<p><span lang="EN-US" style="">The</span>
proposed development, by reason of its siting in&nbsp;surface water flood zones
3a and fluvial flood zone 1, in<span lang="EN-US" style=""> the absence of an adequate Flood Risk
Assessment to assess the future impacts and provide adequate mitigation
measures,&nbsp; would be likely to result in the displacement of water onto
adjacent land and fail to provide resilience to flooding, to the detriment of
the safety of future occupiers of the application site and adjacent sites,
contrary to&nbsp;</span>Policies S1 12 and SI 13 of the London Plan
(2021), Policy CS1.U of the Harrow Core&nbsp;Strategy (2012), and &nbsp;Policies DM9 and DM10
of the Development Management Policies Local Plan document (2013).</p>
description: Single storey rear extension, Landscaping and steps to rear, External alterations
